# Third-party scripts

These files are copies of the published builds. Do not edit or reformat them.
The new UI loads them from here, not from a CDN, so it works without a third-party
server and offline.

| File | Source | License |
|------|--------|---------|
| `htmx-2.0.4.min.js` | https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.4/dist/htmx.min.js | 0BSD (https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx) |
| `anime-3.2.1.min.js` | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/animejs/3.2.1/anime.min.js | MIT (https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime) |

To update a file, download the new version, change the file name and the version in
`templates/app/base.html`.
